title: Randomised set simulation
statementMd:
Simulate a multiset. `['add', x]` adds one copy, `['remove', x]` removes one copy if present and returns `True` else `False`, `['count', x]` returns the number of copies. Return the results of the `remove` and `count` operations in order.

**Example:** `multiset_ops([["add", 1], ["add", 1], ["count", 1], ["remove", 1], ["cou…)` returns `[2, true, 1, false]`.
